summary: First-run setup automatically reduces daemon reader page caches on small machines and persists the setting in its user service.

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection rebuilding changes.

schema.detail: No schema or config keys change; the existing SMALLCLAIMS_READ_CACHE_KIB override is persisted in the service environment.

rules.detail: No rules or coordinated fleet transition changes.

compatibility.detail: Setup and service installation derive a smaller cache target from installed memory and enforced Linux cgroup limits on small machines, using this build's reader/cache defaults. Larger machines retain the default, and valid explicit overrides take precedence. Detached setup startup receives the same environment.

downtime.detail: Running daemons are not restarted automatically. The selection takes effect on the existing service-install or detached-start paths; service restart retains the written environment.

manual.detail: Setup prints a single plain cache selection line when an override is selected. New users need no manual environment configuration.

recovery.detail: The existing environment override works with prior binaries, and repeating service installation recomputes sizing. Page cache targets are planning budgets, not total RSS ceilings.
